ACME HOSTING DATA-PROCESSING AGREEMENT
Parties: Northwind Clinical Services (Data Controller) and ACME Hosting Inc (Processor)

1. Data Processing. Processor processes personal data on behalf of Controller in connection with hosted clinical trial systems.
2. Retention. Processor shall retain personal data for a period of 36 months following termination of this Agreement.
3. Sub-processors. Processor may engage sub-processors without prior notice; a current list is available at processor's website.
4. Liability. Processor's aggregate liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the 3 months preceding the claim.
5. Breach notification. Processor will notify Controller of a personal data breach within 10 business days.
